build_task_beam_balancing: build a PHYRE beam balancing task with a fulcrum, beam, and ball using creator_lib
create_static_ball_fulcrum: create a static ball object as a fulcrum using C.add with scale and position
create_dynamic_bar_beam: create a dynamic bar object as a beam using C.add and set_center_x positioning
create_dynamic_ball_target: create a dynamic ball object positioned on the beam using C.add with set_left and set_bottom
update_task_spatial_relationship: update the task goal to test if the ball is ABOVE the fulcrum using C.update_task
